title: Siebel CRM Developer
summary: Configures and extends Oracle Siebel CRM, the customer management system many banks, telecoms and insurers still run, using Siebel Tools, eScript, workflows and integration (EAI). Sits in a CRM application team that builds changes and supports the live system for sales and service staff.
dailyDuties: Configure business components, applets and views in Siebel Tools
Write eScript and build workflow processes and business services
Build EAI integration objects and web services with other systems
Run EIM data loads and check data with SQL
Fix production defects and support monthly releases
Customise Open UI screens with JavaScript

skills.expectation: Configure business components, applets, views and screens in Siebel Tools
Write eScript and build workflow processes, business services and runtime events
Build EAI integration objects, data maps and web services, and run EIM loads
Test and fix SOAP web services and XML messages
Write Oracle SQL against Siebel tables to check and fix data
Fix production defects and support releases
Explain designs and fixes to business analysts and testers
Customise Siebel Open UI with JavaScript, presentation models and renderers
Expose and call REST services from Siebel
Write PL/SQL for data fixes and batch jobs
Work on Siebel servers to check logs and run jobs
Turn business requirements into technical designs

certifications.why: Shows the SQL skills used on Siebel data
